# control.io

> control.io is an independent construction-supervision service that flies drones over multistorey building sites, reconstructs each flight as a 3D model, compares it with the official construction schedule, and issues evidence-grade PDF reports that show whether, where and by how much a project is late. It also runs drone thermal and RGB inspections of solar panels.

control.io serves property developers, banks and lenders, municipal building control, insurers and sureties, general contractors, and solar plant owners. Every flight produces a 3D mesh, orthomosaic and point cloud; an AI reads the schedule, permits and contracts into milestones with page citations; and each PDF report carries SHA-256 hashes of every image with the cited documents annexed.

Last updated: 2026-09-23

## On-demand inspections

Owners and building inspectors can order a single drone inspection between planned flights, from the control.io app (App Store and Google Play: coming soon) or the web dashboard, or via [Contact](https://control.io/contact?topic=inspection).

- Promise: ASAP order → car + drone crew on site within 3–4 hours of order confirmation → independent PDF report within 12 hours of the flight.
- Service area: Yerevan and Kotayk (Armenia).
- Kinds: full inspection (whole building, all facades, nadir grid, 3D model, progress against the schedule); revision (re-inspection of open findings after the developer reports them fixed); targeted inspection (specific floors, facades or issues).
- Prices per inspection (AMD, VAT excluded, paid by invoice, no in-app payment): full 180,000 scheduled / 225,000 ASAP; revision 90,000 / 112,500; targeted 120,000 / 150,000. ASAP adds 25%. Scheduled slots must be at least 3 hours ahead.
- Live tracking: order status, crew and arrival window in the app; the report arrives in the app and dashboard.
- Fine print: daylight flying only; strong wind, rain or restricted airspace can move the slot, and control.io calls the site contact if so.
- Details: [Per-inspection prices](https://control.io/pricing#inspections), [How ordering works](https://control.io/#order-from-phone)

## Services

- [Construction progress monitoring & schedule verification](https://control.io/services#progress-monitoring): Scheduled drone flights measure what was actually built and set it against what the schedule says should exist by that date.
- [3D reconstruction & as-built mapping](https://control.io/services#3d-reconstruction): Photogrammetry turns every flight into a measurable 3D mesh, orthomosaic and point cloud.
- [Construction document intelligence](https://control.io/services#document-intelligence): AI reads schedules, permits and contracts and turns them into dated milestones, each with a page citation.
- [High-precision structure & facade inspection](https://control.io/services#structure-facade-inspection): Close-range facade passes capture cracks, missing anchors and envelope defects at a known ground sample distance.
- [Delay evidence reports & real-time monitoring](https://control.io/services#delay-evidence-reports): A live project feed plus PDF reports with hashed imagery and the official documents annexed.
- [Solar panel inspection](https://control.io/services#solar-inspection): Thermal and RGB drone surveys find hot-spots, soiling, cracked cells, disconnected strings and shading.

## Industries

- [Developers](https://control.io/industries/developers): Independent proof of progress for buyers, boards and investors, without waiting for the contractor's monthly report.
- [Banks & lenders](https://control.io/industries/banks-lenders): Release construction loan tranches against measured progress, with evidence your credit committee can file.
- [Municipal building control](https://control.io/industries/municipal-building-control): Check permitted works against what is being built, across many sites, without sending an inspector to every one.
- [Insurers & sureties](https://control.io/industries/insurers-sureties): Underwrite and monitor construction risk with a dated visual record of every insured or bonded site.
- [General contractors](https://control.io/industries/general-contractors): Show owners exactly where the programme stands and defend your own delay claims with the same evidence.
- [Energy & Solar](https://control.io/industries/energy-solar): Thermal and RGB drone inspection of solar farms, with every anomaly pinned to a module.

## Guides

- [What is drone construction progress monitoring?](https://control.io/resources/what-is-drone-construction-progress-monitoring): A plain-language guide to drone construction progress monitoring: how flights, photogrammetry and schedule comparison work together to measure what has been built.
- [How to prove a developer is behind schedule (earned schedule explained)](https://control.io/resources/how-to-prove-a-developer-is-behind-schedule): How to turn construction progress into a delay measured in days using earned schedule, and what evidence you need to prove it to a lender, buyer or court.
- [Drone thermal inspection of solar panels: anomaly classes](https://control.io/resources/drone-thermal-inspection-of-solar-panels): Which solar PV defects a drone thermal inspection finds, how they look in thermal images, how IEC TS 62446-3 classifies them, and what conditions an inspection needs.
